Supreme Court Seeks Swift Decision on TMC Rebel MPs' Disqualification

The Supreme Court has indicated that it expects the Speaker to decide expeditiously on disqualification petitions filed against Trinamool Congress rebel MPs. The court's statement came in response to a matter concerning the delay in the Speaker's decision on these petitions.
